title: New Downtown Luxury Huge Rooftop 10 beds #1
description:
10 Beds 2.5mi to the Heart of Nasville!
A Short Uber to Downtown or anywhere in and around Nashville Newly built
4 Bedrooms 4 full Bath 1 King 1 full bunk with trundle 1 queen with trundle 2 Twin Bunk Beds(4)  
Smart TV's High speed WIFI internet
Fully equipped kitchen
Towels Linens, Iron & Board
Washer Dryer
2 car garage parking
Hand soap lotion shampoo conditioner body wash
Huge Rooftop lounge perfect for large Group people
Smart lock Keyless Entry
Exterior Scurity Camera

The space
4TH BEDROOM (1st floor)
Queen with twin trundle (2 beds), desk, Chair and makeup mirror with light, 43" TV, closet, attached en-suite bathroom with showers.
2 Car GARAGE PARKING (1st floor)

KITCHEN (2nd floor)
Brand new appliances, electric cooking range, oven and microwave/ designer fixtures with all the basic cooking items and dish-ware. Breakfast bar seating with bar stools, Coffee Machine, toast oven, smoothie machine and rice cooker.
DINING AREA, LIVING AREA (2nd floor)
Dining table and Chair with 55" screen TV, 2 accent chairs and 1 sofa.
3RD BEDROOM (2nd floor)
Two Twin bunk beds (4 beds), walk-in closet. Desk, chair and make up mirror with light. Attached bathroom with shower.

MASTER BEDROOM (3rd floor)
King bed, walk-in closet, 45" TV . Desk, Chairs and makeup mirror with light. The attached master bathroom features double sink vanity and large walk-in shower with TWO rain shower.
2ND BEDROOM (3rd floor)
Full bunk bed with twin trundle (2 beds), 43" TV. Desk, chairs and make up mirror. Attached bathroom with large vanity and shower
WASHER AND DRYER (3rd floor)

ROOFTOP DECK (4th floor)
Large private outdoor area with outdoor seating,  picnic table, mini golf and more

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire house. Prior to your stay, we'll provide you with the access code along with entry instructions. Feel free to reach out to the host if you have any questions. Thank you!
